def: The property that reordering the input tokens reorders the outputs in the same way, which pure self-attention has because it ignores token indices.
Information added to a Transformer so that it can tell where in the sequence each token sits.
A trained table with one vector per position, added to the token embedding, which caps the context at the table's length.
A fixed code made of sines and cosines at geometrically spaced frequencies, so that a shift in position is a rotation of the code.
A learned number per head and distance bucket added to the attention scores so they depend on how far apart two tokens are.
Attention with Linear Biases: a fixed penalty proportional to token distance, with a different slope per head, added to the attention scores.
A scheme that rotates each pair of query and key dimensions by an angle proportional to position, so that attention scores depend only on the distance between tokens.
The constant (10,000 in the original paper) that sets the spread of rotation frequencies across dimension pairs and hence the longest wavelength.
Extending a RoPE model's context by scaling positions down into the range seen in training and then fine-tuning briefly.
A context-extension method that scales rotary frequencies unevenly across dimensions and adds a temperature correction to attention.
The maximum number of tokens a model can attend to at once, set by its positional scheme and training.
